$comment: Pilot: deep dive. Decomposition → distribution → raw rows. Two extra dropdown filters on the rail. Change only the tree's 'by' list, the scatter axes and the detail columns.
name: Pilot-Deepdive

Headline Tree.en: VAR t = VALUES ( '매장'[권역] ) VAR hi = TOPN ( 1, t, [매출], DESC ) RETURN "Sales " & FORMAT ( [매출] / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M  ·  Top region: " & CONCATENATEX ( hi, '매장'[권역], ", " ) & " " & FORMAT ( DIVIDE ( MAXX ( hi, [매출] ), [매출] ), "0%" ) & "  ·  click + next to a bar to drill one level"
Headline Tree.ko: VAR t = VALUES ( '매장'[권역] ) VAR hi = TOPN ( 1, t, [매출], DESC ) RETURN "매출 " & FORMAT ( [매출] / 100000000, "0.0억" ) & "  ·  권역 1위 " & CONCATENATEX ( hi, '매장'[권역], ", " ) & " " & FORMAT ( DIVIDE ( MAXX ( hi, [매출] ), [매출] ), "0%" ) & "  ·  막대 옆 +를 눌러 기준을 골라 한 단계씩 내려가기"

Headline Discount.en: VAR t = FILTER ( VALUES ( '제품'[제품명] ), NOT ISBLANK ( [매출] ) ) VAR top5 = TOPN ( 5, t, [평균할인율], DESC ) RETURN "Margin of the 5 most-discounted products " & FORMAT ( CALCULATE ( [이익률], top5 ), "0.0%" ) & "  ·  all other products " & FORMAT ( CALCULATE ( [이익률], EXCEPT ( t, top5 ) ), "0.0%" )
Headline Discount.ko: VAR t = FILTER ( VALUES ( '제품'[제품명] ), NOT ISBLANK ( [매출] ) ) VAR top5 = TOPN ( 5, t, [평균할인율], DESC ) RETURN "할인율 상위 5개 제품의 이익률 " & FORMAT ( CALCULATE ( [이익률], top5 ), "0.0%" ) & "  ·  나머지 제품 " & FORMAT ( CALCULATE ( [이익률], EXCEPT ( t, top5 ) ), "0.0%" )

Headline Detail.en: FORMAT ( [주문건수], "#,0" ) & " orders  ·  Sales " & FORMAT ( [매출] / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M  ·  click a header to sort, right-click a row to copy"
Headline Detail.ko: "주문 " & FORMAT ( [주문건수], "#,0" ) & "건  ·  매출 " & FORMAT ( [매출] / 100000000, "0.0억" ) & "  ·  머리글을 눌러 정렬, 행을 오른쪽 클릭해 복사"

sub.en: Click + next to a bar and pick the next split
sub.ko: 막대 옆 +를 눌러 다음 기준 고르기

sub.en: Dot size = sales · lower right = margin given away to discounts
sub.ko: 점 크기 = 매출 · 오른쪽 아래일수록 할인에 이익을 내준 제품

sub.en: Every order line for the current filters
